jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading. Everything is white line art except the colours described. No text, letters or captions. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a deep river in a forest in thin white line art, tall trees, rocks on the bank. Scene: the main character in his mustard-YELLOW hoodie, black cargo pants and white sneakers, with a short brown beard, smiles amazed and grateful, hugging THREE axes against his chest with both arms: one shining GOLD axe, one shining SILVER axe and one plain old iron axe with a wooden handle, all three clearly visible. Only he and the golden axe have colour. Every object (boats, bowls, buckets, walls, furniture) is drawn WHITE-filled with thin dark outlines, never black-filled; the ground and sky are pure black with thin white lines, no brown, no green, no grey fills.
